content:
Maya Patel: PR up — onboard aurora-6b tokenizer + runtime profile tweaks. Short summary: tighten unk handling, add byte-pair exceptions, bump max_seq to 2048. https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/298

Oliver Chen: @Maya Patel taking a look now :eyes:

ci-bot: CI started — unit tests, tokenizer-smoke, quant-smoke

Samir Gupta: quick heads-up: tokenizer-smoke failing on mismatch count, looks like line ending normalization issue in vocab. Error:
```
AssertionError: mismatch token count (expected 50265 != 50264)
```

Samir Gupta: suspect off-by-one in special token list ordering in tokenizer_config.json. small diff suggestion:
```diff
-  "special_tokens": ["","<pad>"]
+  "special_tokens": ["<pad>",""]
```

Lee Wong: i can give an LGTM after CI is green. also please add a short migration note in the PR about embedding cache compatibility — could break cached indices if tokens shift.

Maya Patel: added migration note + normalization step to the preprocessing tests. repushed — PTAL.

ci-bot: tokenizer-smoke passed ✅ — all green except linting

Oliver Chen: lint failures are tiny (trailing comma + double-quote style). pushing a quick reformat fix now. will merge into the EOD deploy window if no more regressions.

Maya Patel: thanks all :pray: i'll hold the rollout flag until the format patch lands.

Lee Wong: :thumbsup:
